tool: geometry-assert.mjs (SEE-005 Layer-1 ruler + SYS-003 Amendments A-D + SEE-008 A12 + SEE-009 A13/A3-feed + SEE-010 A14/A15)

assertions.name: HEADER_TRANSIT
assertions.threshold: samples of P in bbox(H)+4px = 0 AND polyline segments vs pill bbox g[structural-frame-label] (mask incl) = 0
assertions.reason: no measurable population (N=0): no paths, lane headers, or pills to examine

assertions.name: TEXT_CONTAINMENT
assertions.threshold: title inset>=16 all sides, sibling spread<=4

assertions.name: LABEL_COLLISION
assertions.threshold: edge-label vs boundary strokes inflated w/2 + node titles/sublabels/cards + lane/boundary/edge labels = 0
assertions.reason: no measurable population (N=0): no edge labels to examine

assertions.name: LABEL_ORPHAN
assertions.threshold: label centroid to own polyline <= 24px AND own-wire samples inside label bbox = 0 (ride near, never cover)

assertions.name: ARROWHEAD_DOCK
assertions.threshold: each tip-to-target gap within +-2px of modal (tip = rendered marker centroid via live marker polygon + CTM)

assertions.name: INK_OCCUPANCY
assertions.threshold: union child-node area / container area >= 0.50 AND global ink area / viewBox area >= 0.50 (SVG units, exact attrs)
assertions.reason: no measurable population (N=0): no containers or ink-bearing nodes to examine

assertions.name: CONTAINMENT
assertions.reason: no measurable population (N=0): no nodes, routes, or frames to contain

assertions.name: LAYOUT_SPREAD
assertions.threshold: distinct spec pos[0] count>1 AND content-bbox/viewBox>=0.50 (viewBox from svg.viewBox.baseVal)
assertions.reason: no measurable population (N=0): no nodes or positions to examine

assertions.name: ROUTE_TO_FRAME_CLEARANCE
assertions.threshold: background segment-to-frame-edge >=12px AND per-side spread <=6px over qualified sides only (side counts iff p2min<=36px; <2 qualified => spread NA)
assertions.reason: no measurable population (N=0): no frames or routes to examine

assertions.name: ARROWHEAD_DOCKING
assertions.threshold: actual arrow tip (line end + (tipX-refX)*sw along path) outside target UNION (card+accent) at distance >=6px; inside = FAIL

assertions.name: EDGE_CONSERVATION
assertions.threshold: rendered path count == spec edge count (svg data-spec-edge-count); mismatch = FAIL
assertions.reason: no measurable population (N=0): svg lacks data-spec-edge-count

assertions.name: ARROWHEAD_DIRECTION
assertions.threshold: head end-tangent vs last >=15px composition leg within 30deg (shorter finals are pads; longest leg used when none qualify)
assertions.reason: no measurable population (N=0): no marker-end heads with composition legs

assertions.name: MARGIN_BALANCE
assertions.threshold: rendered |left gap - right gap| <= 5% of viewport width (CSS px at declared viewport; top/bottom reported only)
assertions.reason: no measurable population (N=0): no nodes or frames to examine

assertions.name: INTERNAL_BALANCE
assertions.threshold: |left gap - right gap| <= 10% of frame width (inner edge to nearest held card; top/bottom reported only)
assertions.reason: no measurable population (N=0): no frame holds a card

assertions.name: LABEL_CLEARANCE
assertions.threshold: every edge label >= 24px box-gap from every node card and every node sublabel (A4 24px floor, both directions)
assertions.reason: no measurable population (N=0): no edge labels to examine

assertions.name: READABILITY_FLOORS
assertions.threshold: primary 15px/7:1, context 11px/4.5:1, boundary 13px/4.5:1, edge 11px/4.5:1 (contrast vs sampled backdrop pixels; smallest viewport 1440x900)
